Detection of N protein antibodies to SARS-CoV-2 is carried out by a two-step immunoassay method where biotin and ruthenium N protein conjugates are incubated with human serum or plasma. Streptavidin coated paramagnetic beads are then added in the second step to isolate N protein/antibody complexes and chemiluminescent emissions are measured by a photomultiplier (Figure 1). 090177e194c5df35\Approved\Approved On: 02-Sep-2020 18:27 (GMT) (b) (4) FDA-CBER-2021-5683-0779436
